components.name: Primary Navigation

components.name: Download Button
components.description: The one filled control: CV PDF download.

narrative.overview: A plain-text document pulled out of a store: one measured column of mono type, a framed photograph beside it, dashed rules for panels. Two grounds (white and #070707), blue links, Klein-blue selection, no shadows or gradients. Hierarchy comes from weight, case, prefix, and space, never size.
keyCharacteristics: White or near-black ground; blue links; Klein-blue selection
Static header with wrapping bracket navigation and no menu script

rules.name: The Links-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Blue marks something you can follow; Klein blue appears only as selection.

rules.name: The Tokens-Flip Rule
rules.body: Components use semantic variables; .dark swaps values. No dark: colour utilities.

rules.name: The No-Size-Jump Rule
rules.body: Headings stay at body size; weight, case, prefix, and space carry hierarchy.

rules.name: The Dashed-Means-Container Rule
rules.body: A 1px dashed hairline marks a container; solid lines are for print and hover.

dos: Do use ASCII -> for arrows and generate any ASCII from data
Do colour only links blue and only selection Klein blue
Do keep scrollable ASCII inside a focusable .ascii-wrap
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, glass, or filled cards
Don't add a second typeface or a heading size jump
Don't use → ↗ or emoji; the face has no glyph for them
Don't add an eyebrow above a heading
Don't emulate a terminal with prompts, scanlines, or a blinking cursor
